crossRefs.note: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the…

translations.web: of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.
translations.bsb: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
translations.kjv: Of whom be ➔ thou ware also; for he hath ➔ greatly withstood our words.
translations.asv: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.
